hero.intro: A three-language website for a higher education institute, built to guide students from around the world from discovering a course all the way to applying.
hero.ctaLabel: I want a project like this

client.title: Meet the European Forensic Institute
client.text: The European Forensic Institute is a higher education institute offering accredited bachelor’s and master’s degrees in forensic science, criminology and cybercrime investigation, to students from across Europe and beyond.
client.challengeText: An international audience, lots of courses and an admissions process with specific requirements. The website had to speak to students from different countries in their own language and guide them confidently all the way to applying.
challengePoints: Three languages to keep in order
Bachelor’s and master’s courses to present clearly
Events, open days and news, always up to date

solution.title: What I built
solution.text: Structure first, design second: every decision starts from who will use the website and what they need to find.

items.title: A three-language website
items.text: English, Spanish and Italian, with a language switcher always in view and every version linked to the others, for Google too.

items.title: Course pages
items.text: Bachelor’s and master’s degrees presented the same way, so they’re easy to compare and choose between.

items.title: Admissions journey
items.text: Entry requirements and application steps laid out in order, from first contact to enrollment.

items.title: Events and news
items.text: Open days, webinars and news front and center, turning interest into a first enquiry.

showcase.title: The result, on every screen
showcase.text: Hover over the page to scroll through it.

results.title: What changed
before: Built with a page builder and hard to update
Too many pages, information scattered everywhere
after: Everything pre-built: updating content is easy
A tidy structure, with everything in its place
Solid SEO: structure, copy and data for Google
